summary: Hezbollah IED in southern Lebanon wounds two IDF soldiers, triggering Israeli strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure. Houthis launch first attacks on Riyadh since 2022 ceasefire, while Saudi SKYWASP drones strike Sanaa. Iran mobilizes hundreds of thousands for Basij 'Jan-Feda' force and executes alleged Israeli spy.
key_points: Hezbollah roadside bomb in southern Lebanon security zone injures two IDF reservists, prompting Israeli strikes on Hezbollah surveillance posts and attack infrastructure. (Source: @manniefabian/59190)
Houthis attack Riyadh twice with drones, first such strikes since 2022 Yemen-Saudi ceasefire, causing black smoke at King Khalid International Airport. (Source: @asafroz/53557)
Saudi domestically produced SKYWASP kamikaze drones, modeled on Iran's Shahed-136, strike Houthi-controlled Sanaa with 1,500 km range. (Source: @shin_persian/10196)
Iran executes Hussein Fadran for spying for Israel, passing intelligence that led to attack on missile launch site near Isfahan. (Source: @asafroz/53563)
Basij organizes hundreds of thousands of 'Jan-Feda' registrants in Tehran into battalions with ground, air, and naval training exercises. (Source: @VahidOnline/78434)
Trump declares Iran will not obtain nuclear weapons, says war ending soon, and faces 'big decision' on destroying Iranian regime before Gulf leaders meeting. (Source: @mamlekate/104543)
IDF throws stun grenades at Lebanese Army position near Deir Mimas, forcing withdrawal; Israeli forces then search nearby buildings. (Source: @New_security8200/203838)
French FM spokesperson says France opposed US-Iran war but proposed joint UK-French defensive military operation in Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @SharghDaily/184548)

sections.executive_summary: Hezbollah's IED attack in southern Lebanon's security zone wounded two IDF soldiers, prompting immediate Israeli strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure. Simultaneously, Houthis broke the 2022 ceasefire by striking Riyadh twice, while Saudi Arabia retaliated with its new SKYWASP drones against Sanaa. Iran escalated internal mobilization with hundreds of thousands joining Basij 'Jan-Feda' forces and executed an alleged Israeli spy linked to the Isfahan missile site attack.

points: Basij commander Hossein Taeb announced hundreds of thousands of 'Jan-Feda' registrants in Tehran are being organized into battalions with basic and advanced training across ground, air, and naval domains, following a mass exercise from Imam Hossein Square to Azadi Square. (Source: @VahidOnline/78434)
Taeb declared US forces will soon be expelled from the region and asserted Iran will decisively defend strategic capacities including the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78434)

Iran's judiciary executed Hussein Fadran after conviction for espionage for Israel, alleging he provided intelligence enabling an attack on a missile launch site in the Isfahan area. (Source: @asafroz/53563)

Trump stated Iran will not acquire nuclear weapons, claimed the conflict will end soon, and revealed he faces a 'big decision' on whether to launch extensive military strikes to destroy the Iranian regime ahead of talks with six Gulf Arab leaders. (Source: @mamlekate/104543)

French Foreign Ministry spokesperson said France did not want US-Iran war but confirmed Paris and London proposed a 'fully defensive' military operation in the Strait of Hormuz to ensure maritime security, despite Iranian warnings. (Source: @SharghDaily/184548)

Two IDF reservists were lightly injured when an engineering vehicle struck a Hezbollah-planted IED inside the southern Lebanon security buffer zone, leading to Israeli strikes on Hezbollah surveillance posts and attack infrastructure across multiple sectors. (Source: @manniefabian/59190)
Israeli Army Radio reported the exploded IED was old, placed before the ceasefire, in the Wadi al-Salouqi area of southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393148)
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee stated there is a good military and intelligence relationship between Israel and Saudi Arabia that benefits all parties. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393139)

IDF forces threw stun grenades at a Lebanese Army position established recently on the outskirts of the Christian village of Deir Mimas, forcing Lebanese soldiers to withdraw; Israeli troops then searched nearby buildings before returning. (Source: @New_security8200/203838)
Lebanese media reported hostile warplanes flying over northern occupied Palestine, indicating continued Israeli air activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/43711)

Press TV reported the abduction of its correspondent Naqaa Hamed in the West Bank, describing it as part of a broader pattern of attacks on journalism and attempts to prevent documentation of Israeli crimes. (Source: @presstv/207381)
No other specific Gaza or West Bank operational developments were detailed in the provided messages.

Hezbollah IED in Wadi al-Salouqi, southern Lebanon, wounded two IDF soldiers, prompting Israeli retaliatory strikes on Hezbollah observation posts and terror infrastructure used to plan attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59190)
Israeli Army Radio confirmed the IED was emplaced before the ceasefire and the injured soldiers were reservists. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393148)
Lebanese reports indicate Israeli airstrikes on Wadi al-Salouqi and artillery shelling on Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/43709, @redlinkleb/43718)

IDF patrol confronted Lebanese Army at Deir Mimas, using stun grenades to force withdrawal from a newly established position, then conducted searches of adjacent structures. (Source: @New_security8200/203838)
A Lebanese channel commented vaguely on Hezbollah's presence and Iranian influence, lacking operational specifics. (Source: @mamlekate/104552)

Houthis launched two drone attacks on Riyadh, the first since the 2022 Yemen-Saudi ceasefire, with black smoke observed at King Khalid International Airport. (Source: @asafroz/53557, @yediotnews25/135112, @presstv/207416)

Saudi Arabia struck Houthi-controlled Sanaa with its first domestically produced long-range kamikaze drone, the SKYWASP, a Shahed-136 clone built by Saudi-US joint venture SR2Vector at ~$35K per unit with ~1,500 km range. (Source: @shin_persian/10196)
US Ambassador Huckabee affirmed a strong military-intelligence relationship between Israel and Saudi Arabia. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393139)
Trump prepares to meet leaders of six Gulf Arab states amid escalating rhetoric on Iran. (Source: @mamlekate/104543)
Saudi civil defense issued emergency warning for Riyadh following the Houthi attacks. (Source: @shin_persian/10193)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation on multiple fronts — Hezbollah IEDs in Lebanon, Houthi strikes on Riyadh, Saudi retaliatory drone strikes on Sanaa, and Iran's massive Basij mobilization — indicates a region moving toward broader confrontation. Israel's immediate military response to the IED and its confrontation with the Lebanese Army at Deir Mimas suggest a low threshold for kinetic action. Iran's execution of an alleged Israeli spy and Taeb's threats regarding the Strait of Hormuz signal hardening Iranian posture. Trump's 'big decision' rhetoric ahead of Gulf talks raises the probability of US military involvement. The introduction of Saudi SKYWASP drones adds a new indigenous strike capability to the Yemen theater.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has operationalized its first domestic long-range kamikaze drone against Houthi targets, demonstrating a shift from pure defense to offensive capability. The US-Israel-Saudi intelligence-military nexus acknowledged by Ambassador Huckabee suggests coordinated pressure on Iran-backed axes. France's proposal for a defensive naval operation in the Strait of Hormuz, despite opposing US-Iran war, indicates European willingness to secure energy routes. Gulf states are likely coordinating positions ahead of Trump's meeting, balancing deterrence of Iran with avoidance of all-out war. Lebanon's army compliance with IDF demands at Deir Mimas reflects limited capacity to challenge Israeli enforcement of the security zone.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Hezbollah IED in Wadi al-Salouqi, reportedly emplaced pre-ceasefire, suggests either dormant cells or failure of clearance operations. The SKYWASP drone's Shahed-136 design confirms technology transfer or reverse-engineering from Iran, now used by Saudi Arabia against Iranian proxies. Basij's 'Jan-Feda' mobilization of hundreds of thousands indicates preparation for prolonged internal security or external conflict roles. The pager supply chain investigation linking Taiwan and Hungary companies to explosive devices reveals a sophisticated covert weaponization of civilian logistics. Trump's explicit threat to 'destroy' the Iranian regime marks a rhetorical escalation beyond maximum pressure, potentially signaling imminent policy shift.
